faq.q: What skill levels do you train?
faq.a: Every level — from players just picking up the game to competitive travel and high school athletes. Sessions are built around where you are, not a fixed curriculum.
Lead coach is a 3x collegiate national champion with 35+ years in the game, coaching and playing at every level.

about.org: Lace Up sports is a holistic basketball development, training, and sports navigation organization. We enable student athletes to reach their personal and athletic goals. Our nurturing environment coupled with using "growth mindset" techniques has helped many of our student athletes reach the pinnacle of the sports world and beyond. Our staff is committed to pushing each player to the next level. We present an intense and detailed approach to training and playing the game.
about.mission: Our mission is to create young people who approach every obstacle as a opportunity. Our goal is to successfully develop each student athletes confidence, creativity, leadership, teamwork, and sportsmanship.
about.offer: Lace Up provides highly seasoned and respected coaches so our student athletes can compete at the highest level. Family and quality instruction are the cornerstones of Lace Up. Our coaches are dedicated to developing relationships with our student athletes and their families.

pillars.label: Fundamentals
pillars.body: Footwork, ball handling, shot mechanics. Every session starts here, no matter the age or level.

pillars.label: Mindset
pillars.body: Growth mindset isn't a poster on the wall. Coach Robinson and Coach Dweck build it into the drills.

pillars.label: Built around you
pillars.body: One-on-one, small group, or full squad. Sessions are built around what the player needs that day.

pillars.label: Family
pillars.body: Coach Robinson and Coach Dweck know the families they train, not just the players.
